content:
incident-bot: ALERT: P1 - Billing metering detected token_count drift >15% vs baseline across emitters (us-east-prod). Pager routed to oncall-eng. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/billing-token-drift
iris: taking pager, 🚨 starting live triage
iris: quick check — are customers receiving overage emails?
jules: support says two customers got overage notices, both large volume accounts. screenshots attached to ticket #INC-8721
chris: correlating logs now — emitter-b shows signs of duplicate emits on retry path, emitter-a shows consumer lag
maria: kafka consumer lag: group `billing-emitter-a` currently +15m behind end offsets, spike started ~22:12 UTC
iris: run quick compare of counted_tokens vs source_tokens for last 30m, want delta percent
chris: query snippet to run on analytics DB:
```
SELECT sum(counted_tokens) as counted, sum(source_tokens) as source
FROM billing.token_stream
WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 minutes';
```
chris: results: counted=1,234,567  source=1,020,341  => ~21% delta (confirmed)
jules: mitigation suggestion: temporarily disable overage notification rule on prod for rolling 30m window to avoid spamming customers :no_bell:
iris: agree. applying temporary config: `feature.billing.overage_alerts.enabled=false` for prod (30m)
maria: starting resync job now: `./tools/resync_tokens --consumer=billing-emitter-a --from-offset=12345678 --to-latest --dryrun=false`
oncall-bot: Job queued: resync-job-6215554321 started on runner billing-runner-4 (job id job-99d3)
chris: also prepping a rollback of yesterday's retry-dedupe change that may be re-emitting on certain failure paths
jules: can SRE scale up consumer group for emitter-a while resync runs? we need to catch up offsets faster
sam: scaling consumer group `billing-emitter-a` from 3 -> 6 now. ETA ~2m
iris: customer impact update: suppressed new overage emails; plan to issue credits to affected customers after resync and final reconciliation
maria: resync progress: 40% processed, ETA finish ~12 minutes (processing ~6000 msgs/s)
chris: post-resync plan: run ledger reconcile script `tools/reconcile_ledgers --since=6215550000` and validate token totals before reenabling alerts
jules: creating incident tag `billing-token-drift-6215554321` and linking logs/graphs to incident ticket
iris: assigning owner for follow-up postmortem: billing-eng -> maria (owner). I'll own coordination for customer comms
oncall-bot: UPDATE: resync-job-6215554321 completed successfully on billing-runner-4; processed 3.2M messages; exit=0
maria: reconcile results preliminary: counted and source totals within 0.5% after resync; duplicates traced to retry-dedupe bug during transient broker GC
chris: rolled back retry-dedupe patch on emitter-b (PR #4287) and added additional idempotency guard for emitter retries
jules: re-enabling overage alerts with conservative window (10m) and alert-suppression for accounts flagged in the last incident window
iris: issuing credits to the two impacted customers now, note added to tickets
oncall-bot: Severity downgraded to P2 per oncall confirmation (post-resync validation)
iris: good work team :thumbsup: Moving to monitoring phase. Next steps: full backfill overnight (runbook), root cause writeup, PR for durable idempotency + improved metrics.
maria: opening PR today (dedupe rollback + idempotency) with tests, ETA EOD
jules: drafting customer note: "We detected erroneous overage alerts due to processing lag; accounts were credited and pipeline fixes deployed." Will share for review
iris: thanks all. I'll draft the postmortem tomorrow. Leaving thread open for final reconciliation artifacts and any residual discrepant accounts.
